# @ndigo/openapi

OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for Ndigo apps — spec generation from dispatch metadata + Swagger UI

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `OpenAPIResponseDocs` *(type)* — Documentation for one response status.
- `APIDocsMetadata` *(type)* — Documentation metadata for a single handler method.
- `apiDocs` — Decorator: attach documentation metadata to a handler method.
- `getApiDocs` — Read the `@apiDocs` metadata declared on a handler method.
- `RouteMappingTable` *(type)* — What the generator needs from a handler mapping: the registered route table. `RadixMetadataHandlerMapping` (and any `AbstractHandlerMethodMapping`) satisfies i…
- `OpenAPISchemaObject` *(type)* — A JSON Schema object (subset) — the OpenAPI `schema` field.
- `OpenAPIParameter` *(type)* — An OpenAPI parameter object.
- `OpenAPIRequestBody` *(type)* — An OpenAPI request body.
- `OpenAPIResponse` *(type)* — An OpenAPI operation response object.
- `OpenAPISecurityScheme` *(type)* — An OpenAPI security scheme object (the subset the generator carries). Declared through OpenAPIGeneratorOptions.securitySchemes and referenced by name from oper…
- `OpenAPIOperation` *(type)* — An OpenAPI operation object. Framework-specific conditions are preserved under `x-ndigo-*` extensions rather than dropped.
- `OpenAPIPathItem` *(type)* — An OpenAPI path item — operations keyed by lowercase HTTP method.
- `OpenAPIDocument` *(type)* — The generated OpenAPI 3.0.3 document.
- `OpenAPIGeneratorOptions` *(type)* — Options for OpenAPISpecGenerator.generate.
- `OpenAPISpecGenerator` — Builds OpenAPI documents from the framework's route tables.
- `OpenAPIFormat` *(type)* — Output serialization format.
- `WriteOpenAPISpecOptions` *(type)* — Options for writeOpenAPISpec.
- `writeOpenAPISpec` — Generates an OpenAPI document from route tables and writes it to disk.
